stemMd: If $U=\{1,2,3,4,5,6\}$, $P=\{1,2,4\}$ and $Q=\{2,3,6\}$, what is the complement of $P\cup Q$ in U?
explanationMd: The union contains 1,2,3,4,6. Only 5 remains in U. Complementing after taking the union differs from complementing just one set.

distractorRationale.d: Reports the complement of P alone.
